fields.name: crossings
fields.description: Number of times, since t=0 and up to and including the scene at this decision step, that the cube's x-coordinate has moved from one side of the target's x-coordinate to the other (a crossing happens between two consecutive observed frames when the sign of cube_x minus target_x flips; being near the target without flipping is not a crossing). Each crossing is one arrival of the cube at the target. At step #1 the value is 0. It increases only at the step whose observed frames contain the flip. e.g. 2

fields.name: cube_side
fields.description: Which side of the target line the cube is on in the scene at this decision step (the last frame shown): 'smaller_x' if cube_x < target_x, 'larger_x' if cube_x > target_x. At step #1 it is read from the t=0 frame. e.g. larger_x

fields.name: first_cross_t
fields.description: The timestep at which the cube first crossed the target line, estimated by linear interpolation of cube_x against target_x between the last observed frame on the starting side and the first observed frame on the other side, rounded to the nearest whole timestep. If the flip lies between the scene of one decision step and the first frame of the next step, extrapolate backwards linearly from that next step's first two frames instead (the policy cannot see the earlier scene). Empty at every step before the one whose shown frames contain the first flip; written at that step and never changed afterwards. The cube starts at rest at one extreme of its swing at t=0, so this value is one quarter of the swing period: the cube reaches the target for the k-th time at about (2k-1)*first_cross_t. e.g. 30
